named-query.name: User.findByIdWithFriends
named-query.query: SELECT user FROM User AS user LEFT JOIN FETCH user.friends WHERE user.id = :id

named-native-query.name: User.findCommonFriends
named-native-query.query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN ( SELECT receiving_user_id FROM friendship WHERE requesting_user_id = :id INTERSECT SELECT receiving_user_id FROM friendship WHERE requesting_user_id = :otherUserId );

named-native-query.name: User.findRelevant
named-native-query.query: WITH film_like_count AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM film_like WHERE film_id IN ( SELECT film_id FROM film_like WHERE user_id = :id ) AND user_id <> :id GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT user_id FROM film_like_count WHERE count = ( SELECT MAX(count) FROM film_like_count );
